en.title: dbt's evolution keeps analytics engineering in the platform spotlight
en.summary: dbt-related platform announcements continue to emphasize testing, developer workflow, and governed transformation as strategic parts of the analytics stack.
en.whyItMatters: This matters because analytics is increasingly judged on reliability and governance, not just dashboard output. Teams that treat transformation as a strategic layer improve trust, delivery quality, and long-term platform reuse.

pt.title: A evolucao do dbt mantem analytics engineering no centro da plataforma
pt.summary: Os anuncios recentes ligados ao dbt continuam enfatizando testes, fluxo de desenvolvimento e transformacao governada como partes estrategicas do stack analitico.
pt.whyItMatters: Isso importa porque analytics esta sendo cada vez mais avaliado por confiabilidade e governanca, e nao apenas pela entrega de dashboards. Times que tratam transformacao como camada estrategica melhoram confianca, qualidade de entrega e reuso de plataforma no longo prazo.
